articles.title: OnePlus demonstrates Ace 7 Pro's 200 MP camera with sample photos
articles.description: The OnePlus Ace 7 Pro, a brand-new flagship smartphone, will be unveiled in just a few days. OnePlus has now officially confirmed that the device features a 200 MP main camera and a periscope telephoto camera, and has released a series of sample photos.

articles.title: Xiaomi releases new budget smartwatch in Europe with optional NFC and 21 days battery life
articles.description: Xiaomi has released one of its latest smartwatches in more markets. Now available in Europe, the Smart Band 11 can be purchased with optional NFC connectivity. Both the Smart Band 11 and Smart Band 11 NFC leverage a 2,000-nit AMOLED display, up to 21 days of battery life and are available in multiple colours.
